identity.name: Blitnauts
identity.notes: Blitmap expansion collection. CC0/public-domain rights are strong evidence; lifecycle and file inventory are tracked separately.

evidence.note: Official Blitmap publication uses the same Discord community link.
Official October 2021 Blitnauts update describes the release as about one month earlier.
Historical collection records resolve first launch activity to Sep. 10, 2021.

ip_rights.summary: Blitnauts and the broader Blitmap assets were released into the public domain/CC0, so reuse is not conditioned on token ownership.

evidence.note: Official Blitmap publication announces the project art as public domain and describes the public-domain expansion model.

project_status.note: Evidence-based lifecycle inference: the official site, Discord and X links remain reachable, but the official publication surfaces checked are dominated by the original 2021-era launch/public-domain material and no project shutdown announcement was found. Dormant is used rather than sunset.
